comments.author: @stephenglover2183
comments.text: I worked in the office of an export firm in 1972/73 and we supplied electrical cable in tea chests and other packaging, the crown agents purchased from us and we used to send one or two teachests of cable to Tristan da cunha, i was 17 and 18 then and not long out of school and i auctually knew where tristan da cunha was unlike a few of the others who worked there.

replies.author: @themaps26
replies.text: That’s an incredible historical detail! It’s wild to think about the unique logistics involved in getting basic supplies to the most remote island on Earth back then. Thank you so much for sharing that memory
